title.zh: OpenAI正洽谈收购加密安全公司Trail of Bits
title.en: OpenAI正洽谈收购加密安全公司Trail of Bits

current_state.zh: OpenAI正与加密安全公司Trail of Bits进行早期收购谈判，据报道此举由发现办公室隐藏录音设备及一名工程师被捕的安全事件所引发。
current_state.en: OpenAI is reportedly in early-stage acquisition talks with crypto security firm Trail of Bits, reportedly triggered by a security incident involving a hidden recording device found in its offices and the arrest of an engineer.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI正洽谈收购加密安全公司Trail of Bits
updates.title_en: OpenAI正洽谈收购加密安全公司Trail of Bits
updates.what_changed_zh: 据报道，OpenAI正与加密安全公司Trail of Bits进行早期收购谈判，以扩展其网络安全能力，此前双方联合发起了“Patch the Planet”漏洞搜寻计划。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI is reportedly in early-stage acquisition talks with crypto security firm Trail of Bits to expand its cybersecurity capabilities, following their joint 'Patch the Planet' vulnerability-hunting initiative.
updates.current_state_zh: 据报道，OpenAI正与加密安全公司Trail of Bits进行早期收购谈判，以扩展其网络安全能力，此前双方联合发起了“Patch the Planet”漏洞搜寻计划。
updates.current_state_en: OpenAI is reportedly in early-stage acquisition talks with crypto security firm Trail of Bits to expand its cybersecurity capabilities, following their joint 'Patch the Planet' vulnerability-hunting initiative.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: OpenAI is reportedly in early-stage acquisition talks with crypto security firm Trail of Bits to expand its cybersecurity capabilities, following their joint 'Patch the Planet' vulnerability-hunting initiative.
updates.detailed_summary_en: OpenAI is reportedly in early-stage acquisition talks with crypto security firm Trail of Bits to expand its cybersecurity capabilities, following their joint 'Patch the Planet' vulnerability-hunting initiative.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI在办公室窃听丑闻中考虑收购安全公司
updates.title_en: OpenAI eyes security firm purchase amid office bugging scandal
updates.what_changed_zh: 收购谈判被报道是由一起安全事件引发的：OpenAI会议室发现隐藏录音设备，一名工程师已被FBI逮捕。
updates.what_changed_en: The acquisition talks are reported to be motivated by a security incident: a hidden recording device found in an OpenAI conference room, with an engineer arrested by the FBI.
updates.current_state_zh: OpenAI正与加密安全公司Trail of Bits进行早期收购谈判，据报道此举由发现办公室隐藏录音设备及一名工程师被捕的安全事件所引发。
updates.current_state_en: OpenAI is reportedly in early-stage acquisition talks with crypto security firm Trail of Bits, reportedly triggered by a security incident involving a hidden recording device found in its offices and the arrest of an engineer.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: OpenAI is reportedly in talks to acquire cybersecurity auditor Trail of Bits — a firm whose clients include Arbitrum, Uniswap and Aave — following the discovery of a hidden recording device planted in one of OpenAI's conference rooms.
updates.detailed_summary_en: OpenAI is reportedly in talks to acquire cybersecurity auditor Trail of Bits — a firm whose clients include Arbitrum, Uniswap and Aave — following the discovery of a hidden recording device planted in one of OpenAI's conference rooms.
